method: Exploratory one-pass verification repair for every completed proposal failing executable tests, with intact context and security. No retry of exhausted/no-answer tasks. Original campaign remains immutable. Full original source is supplied as untrusted data; no tools or compaction; one model call and Bun grading. Incremental usage/latency must be added to the originating task.
